name: moonpenny
riskyAreas: src/auth.ts: sign-up, sign-in, deleteAccount (reauth, wipe, deleteUser), pending nickname
src/store.ts and src/localStore.ts: wipeAccount, saveProfile, subscriptions
firestore.rules: users doc hasOnly fields, ledger membership, expense shapes
src/cards.ts and src/utils.ts: totals, rounding, month boundaries, recurring items
src/currency*: live rates, fallback, mixed currencies
App.tsx: routing, first sign-in currency detection, env var fallback to local mode
export and report: CSV and PDF totals match the screen
ignore: Stop-hook warnings about unpushed commits are false alarms
Firebase web API keys in EXPO_PUBLIC_* are public by design
